service: Passport Application (Ordinary e-Passport)
requirements: Original National Identity Card (Metal/Plastic/e-ID); Original Birth Certificate; Marriage Certificate (if applicable for female applicants changing surname); Proof of payment receipt
fees_summary: Ordinary Processing Fee: $100; Application Form Token: $20
steps_summary: Book appointment online or report to Civil Registry Passport Office | Purchase application form and pay prescribed fee at cash counter | Document verification against National Population Register | Biometric capture (digital photo, fingerprints, signature) | Collect e-passport upon presentation of receipt and ID

service: Emergency 24-Hour e-Passport Application
requirements: Original National Identity Card; Original Birth Certificate; Proof of emergency requirement (medical referral, travel ticket, or urgent call letter); Proof of payment receipt
fees_summary: Emergency Processing Fee: $200; Application Form Token: $20
steps_summary: Present at Central Passport Office (Makombe Complex) | Request emergency processing approval at Supervisor Counter | Pay $200 emergency fee at official bank counter | Priority biometric capturing | Collect passport next working day

service: Birth Certificate Registration (Newborn)
requirements: Hospital or Clinic Birth Confirmation Slip (Yellow Record); Original National Identity Cards of both parents; Parents' Marriage Certificate (if married); Witness with ID (if home birth)
fees_summary: Newborn Initial Registration Fee: $0; Late Registration Search Fee: $2
steps_summary: Obtain birth confirmation record from hospital where child was born | Both parents visit local Civil Registry sub-office with IDs | Verification of parents' details and marriage status | Issuance of initial long-form Birth Certificate

service: National Identity Card (ID) Replacement & Issuance
requirements: Original Birth Certificate; Proof of residence (utility bill or letter from headman/chief); Police loss report (if replacing lost ID)
fees_summary: First Time National ID Fee: $0; Lost ID Replacement Fee: $2
steps_summary: Report loss to nearest Zimbabwe Republic Police (ZRP) station for RRB receipt (if lost) | Visit nearest District Civil Registry sub-office | Verification of birth certificate details against database | Photo capture and thumbprint verification | Receive temporary paper ID / printed plastic ID card

service: Private Business Corporation (PBC) Registration
requirements: Proposed PBC Name (up to 5 choices); Approved Name Availability Form (CR1); Member Details (1 to 20 members: full names, IDs, addresses); Accounting Officer Consent Letter & Practice Number; Physical Business Office Address
fees_summary: Name Search & Reservation Fee (CR1): $5; PBC Incorporation Statutory Fee: $15
steps_summary: Apply for Company Name Search online via CORES portal (cores.dcip.gov.zw) | Receive Name Reservation approval confirmation | Draft Incorporation Statement (Form PBC 2) detailing member shares and accounting officer | Upload signed PBC 2 form and national ID copies of members | Pay statutory fee of $20 total and receive PBC Certificate of Incorporation

service: Private Limited Company (Pvt Ltd) Incorporation
requirements: Approved Name Availability Search (CR1); Memorandum and Articles of Association; Notice of Situation of Registered Office (Form CR5); Particulars of Directors and Secretaries (Form CR6); Copies of National IDs of minimum 2 Directors
fees_summary: Name Search Fee: $5; Company Incorporation Fee: $80
steps_summary: Submit name search application via CORES portal | Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association | Prepare Form CR5 (Registered Address) and Form CR6 (Directors Details) | Upload signed forms and director ID copies to online portal | Pay statutory incorporation fee ($85 total) | Receive digital Certificate of Incorporation and certified CR5/CR6 forms

service: Trademark Registration
requirements: Clear representation/logo of the Trademark; Applicant Details (Individual or Corporate); Specification of Goods and Services under Nice International Classification; Form TM 1 Application Form; Power of Attorney (Form TM 50, if filed by patent agent)
fees_summary: Trademark Official Application Fee: $100; Publication and Registration Fee: $100
steps_summary: Conduct preliminary trademark search at Intellectual Property Registry | File Form TM 1 with trademark representation and classification | Formal examination and substantive search by IP examiner | Acceptance and advertisement in the Patent and Trademark Journal | Await 2-month opposition period | Issuance of official Certificate of Registration

service: Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Registration
requirements: Copy of National Identity Card or Valid Passport; Proof of Residence (Utility bill or bank statement less than 3 months old); Proof of Income/Employment (Paystub, contract, or affidavit)
fees_summary: Taxpayer TIN Registration Fee: $0
steps_summary: Visit ZIMRA TaRMS Self-Service Portal (mytaxselfservice.zimra.co.zw) | Click 'Sign Up' and register an SSP user account using mobile number and email | Select 'Register as an Individual' | Fill in personal identification, address, and bank account details | Upload scanned copy of National ID and proof of residence | Submit application; system automatically generates unique Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)

service: Business Taxpayer Onboarding (BP / TaRMS Single Account)
requirements: Certificate of Incorporation / PBC Certificate; Form CR6 (Directors details) & Form CR5 (Business address); Memorandum & Articles of Association; Certified ID copies of all Directors; Stamped Company Bank Account Statement; Signed Public Officer Appointment Letter
fees_summary: Business Taxpayer Registration Fee: $0
steps_summary: Access TaRMS portal and register Organization Account profile | Complete Business Entity details and industry activity codes | Attach company incorporation documents and bank account statement | Upload designated Public Officer letter and National ID | ZIMRA verification officer conducts backend audit | Receive Business TIN and access to ZIMRA Single Account

service: Value Added Tax (VAT) Registration
requirements: Active ZIMRA Business TIN; Proof of annual taxable turnover exceeding threshold ($25,000 USD); Historical sales invoices / client contracts; Certified bank statement; Consent for ZIMRA physical site inspection
fees_summary: VAT Registration Application Fee: $0
steps_summary: Log into TaRMS portal under Taxpayer profile | Submit application for VAT Category Registration | Upload financial statements / invoices demonstrating $25,000 turnover threshold | Schedule physical business premises inspection with ZIMRA inspector | Inspector verifies office location and fiscal device integration readiness | VAT registration approval and issuance of VAT number

service: Tax Clearance Certificate (ITF263) Application
requirements: Fully up-to-date Tax Returns filed (Income Tax, PAYE, QPDs); Compliant Fiscalization (Interfaced Fiscal Electronic Register devices); Zero outstanding tax debt or approved ZIMRA payment plan
fees_summary: ITF263 Tax Clearance Certificate Fee: $0
steps_summary: Log into ZIMRA TaRMS Self-Service Portal | Navigate to 'Services' -> 'Tax Clearance Certificate (ITF263)' | System automatically executes real-time compliance audit on returns and fiscalization | If compliant, download and print the official ITF263 Certificate with verifiable QR Code | If non-compliant, system generates compliance block checklist for remediation

service: PRAZ Supplier and Bidder Annual Registration
agency: Public Procurement Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe
requirements: Certificate of Incorporation / PBC Certificate; Valid ZIMRA Tax Clearance Certificate (ITF263); Company Directors (Form CR6) / Members Details; Company Profile & Physical Office Address; Selected Procurement Category Codes
fees_summary: Local Supplier Annual Registration Fee (per category): $120; Foreign Supplier Annual Registration Fee: $850
steps_summary: Access PRAZ Government Portal (portal.praz.org.zw) | Register account and create Supplier Company Profile | Select specific procurement category codes matching business capacity | Upload valid Tax Clearance Certificate (ITF263) and incorporation documents | Pay prescribed category fee ($120 per category) online or via bank transfer | Receive downloadable PRAZ Supplier Registration Certificate

service: Commercial Postal and Courier Operating License
agency: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe
requirements: Registered Company Incorporation Documents; Detailed 5-Year Business Plan & Network Operations Topology; Security Clearance Certificates for Board Directors; Proof of Financial Standing (Audited accounts / Bank Guarantee); Logistics Vehicle Fleet Inventory & Facility Premises Details
fees_summary: Non-Refundable Application Fee: $500; Initial License Fee (Commercial Courier): $2500
steps_summary: Obtain License Application Form from POTRAZ Headquarters or website (potraz.gov.zw) | Pay non-refundable application processing fee ($500) | Submit completed application along with detailed business plan and security clearances | POTRAZ Technical & Licensing Committee performs evaluation and physical inspection | POTRAZ Board review and approval notification | Pay initial licensing fee ($2,500) and receive Commercial Courier Operating License

service: Value Added Service (VAS) and ISP Class License
agency: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe
requirements: Company Incorporation & Director IDs; Detailed Telecommunications Network Architecture; Quality of Service (QoS) Guarantees & SLA; Data Protection Officer Declaration (Cyber Security Act compliance); Application Processing Fee Payment
fees_summary: Class License Application Fee: $1000; Initial ISP/VAS Operating License Fee: $10000
steps_summary: Submit Class License Application Form to POTRAZ Secretariat | Pay non-refundable application fee ($1,000) | Technical evaluation by POTRAZ Engineering and Legal teams | Publication of application notice in Government Gazette for public review | Board approval and license offer issuance | Payment of Class License Fee ($10,000) and issuance of Operating License

service: Public Supplier Category Upgrade & Modification
agency: Public Procurement Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe
requirements: Active PRAZ Supplier Registration Account; Valid ZIMRA Tax Clearance Certificate (ITF263); Additional Category Selection Form; Proof of Payment for New Category
fees_summary: Additional Procurement Category Fee: $120
steps_summary: Log into existing PRAZ Supplier Portal account | Select 'Modify Categories' or 'Add Category' | Choose new procurement category code matching updated business profile | Confirm tax clearance validity | Pay additional category fee ($120) | Updated certificate immediately available for download

service: Employer Social Security Registration
requirements: Certificate of Incorporation / PBC Certificate; Form CR6 (Directors) & Form CR5 (Business Address); Certified copies of Director IDs; Employee Payroll List with National IDs; Company Bank Details; Completed Form P2 (Employer Registration)
fees_summary: Employer NSSA Registration Statutory Fee: $0
steps_summary: Access NSSA Self-Service Portal (selfservice.nssa.org.zw) or visit NSSA Regional Office | Complete Form P2 (Employer Registration) | Attach company incorporation documents and initial employee payroll list | NSSA inspector verifies details and issues NSSA Employer Social Security Number (SSR) | Access NSSA portal to upload monthly Form P4 returns

service: Employee Pension & Invalidity Grant Registration
requirements: Employee Original National ID Copy; Employee Birth Certificate; Completed NSSA Employee Registration Form P3; Active Employer NSSA Number (SSR); Employee Banking Account Details
fees_summary: Employee Registration Fee: $0
steps_summary: Employer submits Form P3 for new employee within 14 days of employment | Attach employee National ID copy and banking details | NSSA system assigns unique individual Social Security Number (SSN) | Monthly statutory pension contribution (4.5% employee + 4.5% employer) remitted via portal

service: Voluntary Informal Sector Pension Scheme (VIPS)
requirements: Applicant National ID Card; Proof of Informal Business activity (Vendor permit or affidavit); 1 Passport-sized photo; Nominated Beneficiary National ID Details
fees_summary: VIPS Scheme Initial Joining Fee: $0
steps_summary: Informal trader / self-employed citizen visits NSSA branch or mobile kiosk | Fill in Voluntary Informal Sector Pension (VIPS) enrolment form | Select preferred monthly contribution tier | Receive NSSA VIPS Membership Card and USSD / EcoCash payment code | Make monthly contributions to secure pension retirement benefit

service: Vehicle Licence Disc Renewal
requirements: Vehicle Registration Book (Logbook); Valid Third Party Vehicle Insurance Certificate; Active ZBC Radio Licence Token; Current Vehicle Licence Registration Number
fees_summary: ZINARA Road Levy (Light Passenger Vehicle): $20; ZBC Radio Licence Fee: $23
steps_summary: Ensure valid third-party motor insurance is active | Visit ZINARA licensing desk, ZimPost office, or access online banking app | Provide vehicle registration mark and insurance cover note details | Pay prescribed road levy ($20 per term) plus ZBC radio token | Print or collect valid self-adhesive ZINARA Vehicle Licence Disc
processing_time: Immediate counter service / instant online print

service: Provisional Driver's Licence Application
requirements: Original National Identity Card or Valid Passport; 2 Passport-sized photographs (white background); Passed Eye Test Verification; Age eligibility: 16 years for Class 4 (light motor), 18 years for Class 2 (heavy truck)
fees_summary: VID Provisional Written Examination Fee: $20
steps_summary: Report to VID Depot (e.g. VID Eastlea Harare or VID Bulawayo) | Present original National ID and pay $20 exam fee at cash desk | Undergo vision acuity eye test with VID officer | Enter examination hall for 25-question multiple choice test on Highway Code rules | Score minimum 22 out of 25 (88%) to pass | Receive laminated Provisional Driver's Licence valid for 12 months

service: Commercial Vehicle Certificate of Fitness (COF)
requirements: Vehicle Registration Logbook; Active Commercial Transport Operator License; Compliant Safety Accessories (Fire extinguisher, 2 red warning triangles, emergency first aid kit); Reflective Tapes & Speed Governor (for heavy buses/trucks)
fees_summary: Class 4 Taxi / Light Commercial COF Inspection: $30; Class 1 & 2 Bus / Heavy Truck COF Inspection: $50
steps_summary: Drive commercial vehicle to VID Depot pit lane | Present registration book and pay statutory inspection fee at cash desk | VID examiner executes mechanical audit (brakes, steering, tires, chassis, lights, wipers) | If vehicle passes audit, examiner stamps logbook and issues Certificate of Fitness (COF) disc | Affix COF disc to commercial vehicle windscreen

service: Temporary Employment Permit (TEP / Work Permit)
requirements: Application Form IF1; Employer Letter of Justification (proving specialized skills not available locally); Understudy Training Plan for Zimbabwean Citizen; Applicant CV and Certified Educational Qualifications; Police Clearance Certificate from country of origin (<6 months old); Medical Clearance Certificate & Chest X-Ray; Passport Copy (valid >6 months)
fees_summary: TEP Application Fee: $500; Annual Work Permit Fee upon Approval: $1500
steps_summary: Employer submits Form IF1 and dossier to Department of Immigration Headquarters (Linquenda House, Harare) | Foreign Employment Committee evaluates justification and understudy plan | Inter-agency security vetting | Immigration Board issues approval letter | Pay annual permit fee ($1,500) and receive TEP endorsement sticker in passport

service: Business Investor Residence Permit
requirements: Zimbabwe Investment and Development Agency (ZIDA) Investor License; Proof of Foreign Direct Capital Inflow (minimum $100,000 USD banked into Zimbabwe); Company Incorporation & Tax Registration Certificate; Police Clearance Certificate from origin country; Medical Certificate; Detailed Business Plan & Employment Generation Schedule
fees_summary: Investor Residence Permit Application Fee: $500; 5-Year Investor Residence Permit Fee: $2000
steps_summary: Obtain ZIDA Investor License from ZIDA One-Stop Investment Centre | Submit Investor Residence Permit application dossier to Immigration HQ | Financial audit verifies banking of foreign capital inflow | Immigration Board approves 5-year renewable Investor Residence Permit | Endorse Residence Permit sticker in passport

service: Municipal Shop Licence (Business Operating Licence)
requirements: Company Incorporation / PBC Registration Certificate; Valid ZIMRA Tax Clearance Certificate (ITF263); Approved Building Architectural Floor Plan; City Health Inspection Certificate; Fire Department Clearance Certificate; Proof of Newspaper Advertisement (14-day public notice window)
fees_summary: Application & Press Notice Verification Fee: $50; Annual Municipal Shop Licence Fee: $250
steps_summary: Obtain Shop Licence Application Form from Town House / Local Municipality | Publish public notice in 2 editions of local newspaper for 14-day objection period | Schedule joint site inspection with City Health, Fire, and Town Planning departments | Submit inspection clearance reports and pay annual licence fee | Receive Municipal Shop Licence disc for display on business premises

service: Municipal Food Handler's Health Certificate
requirements: Employee Original National Identity Card; 2 Passport-sized photographs; Medical Examination & Laboratory Test Results from Municipal Health Clinic; Inspection Fee Payment Receipt
fees_summary: Food Handler Medical Exam & Card Fee: $15
steps_summary: Food handling personnel report to Municipal Infectious Diseases Clinic | Undergo physical examination, chest X-ray, and lab screening for communicable diseases | Doctor certifies medical clearance | City Health Department issues official Food Handler's Health Card (Red Card) | Keep card available for municipal health inspector audits on premises

service: Death Certificate Registration & Issuance
requirements: Medical Certificate of Cause of Death (BD 11 Form from hospital/doctor); Original National Identity Card of Deceased; Original Birth Certificate of Deceased (if available); Informant National Identity Card (Relative or representative); Burial Order / Mortuary Notification
fees_summary: Initial Death Certificate Registration Fee: $0; Duplicate Death Certificate Search Fee: $2
steps_summary: Obtain Medical Certificate of Cause of Death (Form BD 11) from attending medical practitioner | Informant reports to District Civil Registry Office with deceased's ID and BD 11 form | Civil Registry officer cancels deceased's ID and records death entry in register | Receive Burial Order for mortuary/cemetery clearance | Long-form Death Certificate printed and issued to informant

service: Civil Marriage Registration & Certificate
requirements: Bride and Groom National Identity Cards or Valid Passports; Original Birth Certificates of both parties; 2 Adult Witnesses with National IDs; Divorce Decree or Death Certificate of former spouse (if previously married); Marriage Notice Publication (if applicable)
fees_summary: Marriage License Notice & Solemnization Fee: $25
steps_summary: File Notice of Intention to Marry at Civil Registry Office or Magistrates' Court | Notice published on court noticeboard for 21 days (or apply for Special Marriage License) | Appear before Magistrate or Marriage Officer with 2 witnesses | Solemnization of marriage under Marriages Act [Chapter 5:15] / [Chapter 5:17] | Sign Marriage Register and receive official Marriage Certificate

service: Motor Vehicle Customs Import Duty Clearance
requirements: Original Vehicle Export Documentation / Registration Logbook; Commercial Purchase Invoice / Bill of Sale; Bill of Lading / Transport consignment note; Importer National ID / Passport Copy; ZIMRA Customs Clearance Declaration Form (Form SAD 500)
fees_summary: Customs Duty Rate: $0; Customs Assessment Processing Fee: $20
steps_summary: Present vehicle and shipping documents at ZIMRA Port of Entry (Beitbridge, Forbes, Chirundu) or inland port | Customs Agent submits SAD 500 declaration on ZIMRA ASYCUDA World system | ZIMRA Customs valuation officer inspects vehicle and verifies CIF value | Pay assessed Customs Duty, Surtax, and VAT | Receive Customs Clearance Certificate (Form 49) and ZIMRA Gate Pass for vehicle registration

service: Medicines Distribution & Wholesale Premises License
requirements: Registered Pharmacist Supervisory Clearance (Pharmacist Council of Zimbabwe retention); Company Incorporation Docs (Pvt Ltd); Premises Floor Plan conforming to Good Wholesale Practice (GWP); Security System (Vault/CCTV/Access control); Application Form M2
fees_summary: Premises Inspection Fee: $300; Annual Wholesale Licensing Fee: $1200
steps_summary: Submit Application Form M2 with layout plans and pharmacist details to MCAZ Secretariat | Pay non-refundable inspection fee ($300) | MCAZ Inspectorate performs physical audit of temperature controls, security, and storage facility | Inspectors submit report to MCAZ Licensing Committee | Upon approval, pay annual licensing fee ($1,200) and receive Wholesale Premises License

service: Standards Mark Quality Certification
requirements: Company Registration & Tax Clearance; Product Technical Specification Sheet; Factory Quality Management System (QMS / ISO 9001 documentation); Product Test Samples for laboratory analysis; Application Form SAZ 1
fees_summary: Product Laboratory Testing Fee: $250; Annual Standards Mark Licensing Fee: $800
steps_summary: File Application Form SAZ 1 with product specifications at SAZ headquarters | Submit product samples for laboratory testing against Zimbabwean Standard (ARS/ZS) | SAZ auditors conduct factory floor Quality Management System audit | Upon meeting standard compliance, SAZ awards Quality Certification Mark | Affix SAZ Quality Mark on product packaging

service: Open General Import Licence (OGIL) / Import Permit

fees_summary: Import Permit Application Processing Fee: $30
steps_summary: Access Ministry of Industry and Commerce e-Services portal | Complete Import Permit Application Form MIC 1 with tariff codes (HS Codes) | Attach proforma invoice and valid ZIMRA Tax Clearance | Pay $30 application processing fee | Ministry officials audit import justification against domestic production reserves | Receive digital Import Permit clearance for ZIMRA customs border entry

service: Export Registration and CD1 Form Customs Clearance
requirements: Registered Exporter Profile on RBZ CEEC System; Valid ZIMRA Tax Clearance (ITF263); Export Sales Contract / Invoice; Bill of Lading / Airway Bill; CD1 Export Declaration Form
fees_summary: Export Clearance Processing Fee: $0
steps_summary: Register Exporter profile on RBZ Computerised Export Exchange Control System (CEEC) | Generate online Form CD1 for commercial export consignment | Submit CD1 form along with export contract and invoice | ZIMRA Customs performs physical border export inspection and seals container | Acquit CD1 form with RBZ within 90 days upon receipt of foreign export proceeds

service: Prospecting Licence & Mining Claim Registration
agency: Ministry of Mines and Mining Development
requirements: Applicant National ID / Company Registration Documents; Certificate of Financial Capability; Completed Form M1 (Prospecting Application); Landowner Notification Acknowledgment / Communal Chief Clearance; Engagement of Registered Approved Prospector
fees_summary: Prospecting Licence Statutory Fee: $200; Mining Claim Pegging & Registration Fee: $100
steps_summary: Submit Form M1 at Provincial Mining Commissioner's Office | Purchase Prospecting Licence ($200) | Engage registered Approved Prospector to post Prospecting Notice (DPN) on ground | Await statutory 30-day notice window | File Registration Application with sketch map and GPS coordinates | Mining Commissioner issues Mining Claim Certificate of Registration

service: Mineral Export & Movement Permit
agency: Ministry of Mines and Mining Development
requirements: Mining Claim Registration Certificate; Fidelity Gold Refinery (FGR) / Minerals Marketing Corporation (MMCZ) Clearance; Royalties Payment Clearance from ZIMRA; CID Minerals Flora & Fauna Unit Security Clearance
fees_summary: Mineral Movement Permit Application Fee: $50; Royalty Rate (Gold / Platinum / Lithium): $0
steps_summary: Assay mineral sample at Fidelity Gold Refinery or MMCZ laboratory | Pay statutory mining royalties to ZIMRA | Obtain CID Minerals & Border Control security clearance | Submit application to Ministry of Mines Mining Commissioner | Receive Mineral Movement & Export Permit

service: Livestock Movement Permit & Veterinary Clearance

steps_summary: Report livestock sale to local ZRP station for Stock Theft clearance (Form 392) | Request Veterinary Department officer to inspect cattle at dip tank | Vet officer verifies brand marks, ear tags, and health status | Pay veterinary permit fee ($5 + $1/head) | Receive DVS Livestock Movement Permit valid for 7 days

service: Tobacco Grower Registration & Marketing Number
requirements: Grower National ID Card Copy; Proof of Land Tenure (Title Deed, Offer Letter, A2 Permit, or Communal Chief Certificate); Farm GPS Location Coordinates; Active Bank Account Details
fees_summary: TIMB Early Registration Fee (before Oct 31): $10; Late Registration Fee: $40
steps_summary: Access TIMB Self-Service Portal (portal.timb.co.zw) or visit TIMB Regional Office | Fill in Tobacco Grower Registration Form detailing hectarage and seed variety | Attach proof of land ownership / occupation and ID | Pay registration fee ($10 early bird) | Receive unique TIMB Grower Sales Number for auction floor deliveries

service: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Certificate

fees_summary: EIA Review & Certification Fee: $210
steps_summary: Submit Project Prospectus to EMA Director General for screening | Engage registered independent Environmental Consultant to conduct EIA study | Publish public notice in national newspapers for 21-day stakeholder feedback | Submit comprehensive EIA Report to EMA for technical evaluation | EMA Technical Committee performs physical site inspection | Issuance of 2-Year Renewable EIA Certificate

service: Effluent and Waste Discharge Licence
requirements: Active EMA EIA Clearance / Registration; Waste Management & Effluent Treatment Layout; Laboratory Test Results of Waste Discharge Samples; Completed Form EMA W1
fees_summary: Effluent Discharge Licence Classification Fee: $150
steps_summary: Submit Waste Management Plan and Form EMA W1 to EMA Regional Office | EMA laboratory technicians collect effluent samples from discharge points | Laboratory analysis classifies discharge quality into environmental risk bands | Pay annual effluent discharge licence fee based on classification band | Receive EMA Effluent & Waste Discharge Licence

service: Bureau de Change Operating License
requirements: Proof of Minimum Paid-up Capital ($50,000 USD banked at RBZ designated bank); Incorporation Documents (Pvt Ltd); Anti-Money Laundering & Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) Policy Manual; CID Vetting and Security Clearances for all Directors and Shareholders; Secure Physical Operating Premises with Vault and CCTV
fees_summary: RBZ Bureau de Change Application Fee: $1000; Initial Annual Operating License Fee: $2500
steps_summary: Submit formal application dossier to RBZ Exchange Control Division | Deposit required minimum capital reserve ($50,000) into designated bank account | Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) conducts AML/CFT compliance audit and CID vetting | RBZ Exchange Control Committee conducts physical premises inspection | RBZ Governor grants approval and issues Bureau de Change Operating Licence

service: Microfinance Institution (MFI) Registration

fees_summary: MFI Registration Application Processing Fee: $500; Annual MFI Operating Licence Fee: $1500
steps_summary: Submit Microfinance Licence application form MFI 1 to RBZ Supervision Division | Pay $500 non-refundable application fee | RBZ Bank Supervision officers conduct vetting of directors and capital verification | On-site inspection of credit administration systems and IT infrastructure | RBZ grants Microfinance Operating Licence under Microfinance Act [Chapter 24:29]

service: Electricity Service Connection & Prepaid Meter Installation
agency: Zimbabwe Electricity Transmission and Distribution Company
requirements: Proof of Property Ownership / Title Deed / Municipal Stand Allocation / Lease Agreement; National ID Copy of Applicant; Wiring Certificate signed by Registered Electrical Contractor; Completed Service Connection Application Form ZET 1
fees_summary: Standard Single-Phase Meter Connection Fee: $100; Three-Phase Industrial Meter Connection Fee: $350
steps_summary: Engage ZETDC-certified electrical contractor to complete property internal wiring | Contractor issues signed Electrical Wiring Completion Certificate | Submit Form ZET 1 and wiring certificate to nearest ZETDC Client Service Centre | Pay prescribed meter connection fee ($100 single-phase) | ZETDC meter technicians inspect wiring and install smart prepaid meter

service: Petroleum Retail & Fuel Station Operating Licence
requirements: Approved EMA EIA Clearance Certificate; Local Authority Town Planning & Building Approval Permit; Chief Fire Officer Inspection Clearance Certificate; Fuel Storage Tank Pressure Test & Calibration Certificates; Company Incorporation Documents & ZIMRA Tax Clearance
fees_summary: Urban Petroleum Retail Licence Fee: $2000; Rural Service Station Licence Fee: $500
steps_summary: Apply for Petroleum Retailer Licence via ZERA e-portal (zera.co.zw) | Upload EMA EIA certificate, Fire Brigade clearance, and council permits | ZERA Technical Engineers conduct physical safety audit of pumps and underground tanks | ZERA Board approves licence application | Pay annual retail licensing fee ($2,000 urban / $500 rural) and receive ZERA Licence Disc

service: Tourist Facility & Hotel Operating Licence

fees_summary: Designated Tourist Facility Licence Fee: $150
steps_summary: Submit ZTA Form 1 to Zimbabwe Tourism Authority Licensing Department | Attach local authority operating licence, fire clearance, and health certificate | ZTA Quality Assurance Inspectors perform physical room and hygiene grading inspection | Facility assigned star rating / tourist facility classification | Pay annual ZTA tourism licence fee and receive ZTA Registration Certificate

service: Foreign Qualification Assessment & Equivalence Certificate
requirements: Original Degree / Diploma Certificate from Foreign Institution; Official Academic Transcripts (sealed / certified); National Identity Card or Passport Copy; English Translation (if original documents are in foreign language); Application Form ZIMCHE 1
fees_summary: Foreign Qualification Equivalence Assessment Fee: $100
steps_summary: Submit Form ZIMCHE 1 along with certified degree certificates and transcripts to ZIMCHE HQ | Pay $100 qualification assessment fee | ZIMCHE Qualifications Framework Committee verifies accreditation status of foreign university | Academic equivalence mapping against Zimbabwe National Qualifications Framework (ZNQF) | Issuance of official ZIMCHE Certificate of Equivalence

service: Private Vocational & Training College Registration
agency: Ministry of Higher and Tertiary Education
requirements: Company Incorporation / Trust Registration Certificate; Curriculum and Syllabus Details conforming to HEXCO standards; Tutor & Lecturer Qualifications (Minimum Higher National Diploma / Bachelor's Degree); City Health and Fire Safety Clearance Certificates; Physical Classroom & Workshop Infrastructure Approval
fees_summary: Private College Inspection Fee: $150; Annual HEXCO College Registration Fee: $500
steps_summary: Submit Application Form HT-1 to Ministry of Higher & Tertiary Education (HEXCO Secretariat) | Attach company incorporation documents, lecturer CVs, and curriculum syllabus | Ministry Quality Assurance Committee conducts physical inspection of classrooms and labs | Pay annual HEXCO college registration fee ($500) | Issuance of Certificate of Registration for Private Tertiary Institution

service: Medical Practitioner Annual Practising Certificate

requirements: MBChB / Medical Degree Certificate; Internship Completion Certificate from Teaching Hospital; Good Standing Certificate from previous council; CPD Points Credit Summary; Form MDPCZ 1
fees_summary: General Medical Practitioner Annual Practising Fee: $150; Specialist Medical Practitioner Annual Fee: $300
steps_summary: Submit Form MDPCZ 1 and credentials to MDPCZ Registrar | Credentials Committee verifies medical degree and internship logbook | Pay annual practising fee ($150 GP / $300 Specialist) | Receive MDPCZ Practising Certificate and entry into Official Medical Register

service: Pharmacy Retail Operating Licence
requirements: Registered Pharmacist Retention Certificate; Premises Floor Plan conforming to Pharmacy Regulations; MCAZ Storage Approval; Company Incorporation Documents
fees_summary: Retail Pharmacy Premises Licence Fee: $500
steps_summary: Submit Retail Pharmacy Premises Application to Pharmacists Council | Council Inspector performs physical layout and security audit | Verify registered Supervising Pharmacist presence | Pay annual retail licence fee ($500) | Issuance of Pharmacists Council Retail Pharmacy Licence

service: Legal Practitioner Admission & Practising Certificate
requirements: Bachelor of Laws (LLBS) Degree Certificate; Council of Legal Education (CLE) Professional Examination Certificate; High Court Admission Order; Police Clearance Certificate
fees_summary: Law Society Initial Practising Certificate Fee: $300; Fidelity Guarantee Fund Contribution: $200
steps_summary: Pass Council of Legal Education professional examinations | Petition High Court of Zimbabwe for formal admission as Legal Practitioner, Notary Public & Conveyancer | Submit High Court Admission Order to Law Society of Zimbabwe Secretariat | Pay practising certificate fee ($300) and Fidelity Fund bond | Receive Law Society Practising Certificate

service: Estate Agent Registration & Practising Certificate

fees_summary: Estate Agent Registration Fee: $200; Annual Practising Certificate Fee: $300
